name: zeffect_anim_process_activation_record
description: zEffect_Anim::ProcessActivationRecord resolves an animation activation record and dispatches command types 1 through 4 to the corresponding zEffectAnim thunk.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the missing-animation early return. The command dispatch paths are source-matched from Binary Ninja and rely on accepted FindEntryByName, GameZ_ZBD::NodeIndexToPtr, and zEffectAnim activation thunk functional targets.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zEffect activation-record source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x461870 validates resolving the animation by record animName, returning null when it is missing, dispatching command types 1 through 4 through the switch table, resolving node tokens through GameZ_ZBD::NodeIndexToPtr, forwarding record params to SetTransformRotAndVelocity_Thunk, SetVelocity_Thunk, SetPositionRefAndVelocity_Thunk, or SetTransformRefs_Thunk, and returning the thunk result or null.
The native process-activation-record smoke verifies a missing animName returns null without dispatch.
